05Questions

Asked,
answered.

Everything founders usually ask before we start. Anything else — ask us on WhatsApp.

How much budget do I need for Google Ads?

+

Minimum ₹25,000/month in ad spend for local campaigns. ₹50,000+ for competitive markets. We'll give you exact numbers in the free audit.

How is this different from SEO?

+

Google Ads gives you immediate visibility. SEO is a long-term play. We recommend both — ads for quick wins, SEO for compounding growth.

Do you manage the Google Ads account directly?

+

Yes. We own the campaign management end-to-end — keyword research, ad writing, bid strategy, landing pages, and reporting.

Can I track which keywords bring customers?

+

Absolutely. We set up full conversion tracking so you know exactly which keyword → ad → page → WhatsApp click brought each lead.

What if I've been burned by Google Ads before?

+

Most failed Google Ads campaigns have the same root cause: no landing page, broad keywords, and no tracking. We fix all three from Day 1.
